# Modern Data Engineering

> Build one batch pipeline from raw extracts to a tested, governed open table that two engines read. SDAIA Academy course AE-306, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 17,736 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Store and query](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day1.md): sessions: Platform shapes, Analytical SQL on a single node, Window functions, Columnar files and partitioning; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day1.html; about 4,175 tokens
- [Day 2: Ingest and clean](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day2.md): sessions: Ingesting from APIs, Declarative ingestion pipelines, Change data capture, merge and history, Cleaning with dataframes; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day2.html; about 3,977 tokens
- [Day 3: Model and test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day3.md): sessions: Dimensional modelling, Transformations as code, Data quality tests and contracts, Orchestration; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day3.html; about 3,909 tokens
- [Day 4: Scale and production](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day4.md): sessions: Open table formats, Distributed processing when measured, Streaming fundamentals, Governance with PDPL and NDMO; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day4.html; about 4,173 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the margin mart and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day5.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/slides/day5.html; about 987 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Ten workloads, three layers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D1_1_platform_shapes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Reproduce the monthly margin](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D1_2_margin_sql.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Running margin, price changes, first and last orders](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D1_3_windows.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Partitioned columnar files, measured](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D1_4_columnar.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: An incremental, idempotent API load](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D2_1_api_ingestion.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: The supplier load with dlt](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D2_2_dlt_pipeline.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Supplier changes and their history](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D2_3_cdc_scd.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Currencies, units and Arabic names](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D2_4_cleaning.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: The margin star schema](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D3_1_star_schema.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Models, environments and a state-aware rebuild](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D3_2_transformations.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: A contract that holds](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D3_3_contracts.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Assets, a failure, a retry and a backfill](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D3_4_orchestration.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: The mart as an Iceberg table](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D4_1_table_format.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: One node or a local cluster](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D4_2_distributed.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Shipment events with a watermark](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D4_3_streaming.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Classification, masking and access tests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-306/labs/D4_4_governance.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
